name: notolog
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "notolog" %}
{% set version = "1.2.4" %}
{% set python_min = "3.11" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/notolog-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 65d3468547785cbac92b8b2db25240f85e63fdec785a4d05837baf51b5d8a053

build:
  entry_points:
    - notolog=notolog.app:main
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  number: 0

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - poetry-core >=2.5.0,<3.0.0
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }},<3.15
    - cryptography >=50.0.2,<51.0.0
    - emoji >=2.16.0,<3.0.0
    - markdown >=3.11.2,<4.0.0
    - numpy >=2.4.6,<2.5|>=2.5.4,<3.0.0
    - packaging >=26.3,<27.0
    - psutil >=7.2.2,<8.0.0
    - pygments >=2.21.0,<3.0.0
    - pyside6 >=6.11.3,<6.12.0
    - qasync >=0.28.0,<0.29.0
    - tomli >=2.5.0,<3.0.0
    - tomli-w >=1.2.0,<2.0.0
    - llama-cpp-python >=0.3.36,<0.4.0
    - python-sounddevice >=0.5.6,<0.6.0
    - curl
    - ca-certificates

test:
  imports:
    - notolog
    - sounddevice
  requires:
    - pytest
    - python {{ python_min }}.*
  source_files:
    - tests
    - pyproject.toml
  commands:
    - notolog --version
    - python -c "from importlib.metadata import version; assert version('notolog') == '{{ version }}'"
    - pytest tests/test_pkg_integration.py
    - python -c "import sounddevice; assert sounddevice.get_portaudio_version()[0] > 0"
    - curl --version
    # Package requirements on PyPI differ slightly from those on conda-forge.
    #- pip check

app:
  entry: notolog
  icon: notolog-logo.png
  summary: Cross-platform Markdown editor with optional AI assistance, local LLMs, and file encryption
  own_environment: true

about:
  home: https://notolog.com
  summary: Cross-platform Markdown editor with optional AI assistance, local LLMs, and file encryption
  description: |
    Notolog is an open-source, cross-platform Markdown editor built with Python and PySide6, featuring optional AI assistance, local LLMs, file encryption, and local-first privacy.
  dev_url: https://github.com/notolog/notolog-editor
  doc_url: https://notolog.app
  license: MIT
  license_family: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - tekkidev
    - notolog
